name: tracfin-module-vikings
description: Module TRACFIN pour le monitoring des casinos du groupe Vikings

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 5000)" && pnpm prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 10000)" && pnpm prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed:build: docker build -f database/rust-seeder/Dockerfile -t tracfin-module-example-seeder:latest database/rust-seeder && docker compose --profile tools run --rm seeder
scripts.db:full: pnpm run db:reset && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 10000)" && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:connect: docker compose exec postgres psql -U tracfin_user -d tracfin
scripts.db:backup: docker compose exec postgres pg_dump -U tracfin_user tracfin > backup.sql
scripts.test:connection: docker compose exec postgres pg_isready -U tracfin_user
